test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_date_add_interval (t DateTime('UTC'), d Date, n Int32) Engine = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_date_add_interval SELECT toDateTime('2010-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + cityHash64(number) % 500000000, toDate('2010-01-01') + cityHash64(number, 1) % 6000, toInt32(cityHash64(number, 2) % 100000) - 50000 FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT countIf(addSeconds(t, n) > t AND addHours(t, n % 24) < t + 86400) FROM jit_date_add_interval SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(d + n % 30 > toDate('2020-01-01') OR d - n % 7 < toDate('2012-01-01')) FROM jit_date_add_interval SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(addDays(d, n % 365) = subtractWeeks(d, n % 52)) FROM jit_date_add_interval SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
